title: Applications
subtitle: Uninstalling hides the module and revokes its permissions; historical data is kept.
coreLocked: A core module cannot be uninstalled

confirmUninstall.title: Uninstall “{{name}}”?
confirmUninstall.body: Its screens leave the menu and its permissions are withdrawn from every role. The data is kept: reinstalling brings it back with each role's permissions.

done.installed: “{{name}}” installed. Its new permissions are held by the Administrator: give them to other roles in Permissions.
